newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds see some nearby demand in afternoon.
newsitem.headline: European feeds see some nearby demand in afternoon.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market saw some nearby demand this afternoon as buyers felt the market could have reached a bottom, market sources said.

"After prices for most products dropped substantially over the last weeks we saw some activity today on the feeling we could have hit a bottom, pushing operators to cover their nearby needs ahead of tomorrow's USDA crop figures," one broker said.
Spot Brazilian soymeal pellets traded at $291 a tonne fob Rotterdam, afloat up $1.50 at $286.50 and June at $284 cif.
Afloat and June/July Argentine soymeal pellets both changed hands at $270 a tonne cif Rotterdam.
